candidateGroupTextAndRoles.title: Investigating a label mismatch
candidateGroupTextAndRoles.passage:
Man: The barcodes on the shipping boxes say model R eight. The units inside are model R nine. I have stopped the shipment.
Woman: Keep the boxes in the marked holding area. Compare the labels with the packing list.
Man: The list is correct. The label printer may have used an old template.
Woman: Let’s check the print history. Do not relabel anything until the quality team approves the correction.
candidateGroupTextAndRoles.passageZh:
男：出貨紙箱上的條碼標示 R8 型號，裡面的產品卻是 R9。我已經停止出貨。
女：把紙箱留在有標示的暫存區。請比對標籤與裝箱單。
男：裝箱單沒錯。印表機可能用了舊版標籤樣板。
女：先查列印紀錄。品管部門核准更正之前，不要重貼任何標籤。

41.en: The packing list is explicitly correct, not missing.
41.zh: 男方已查看並說裝箱單正確。

41.en: The shipping-box barcodes identify R8 but the actual units are R9, so the label identifies the wrong model.
41.zh: 箱外是 R8，箱內產品是 R9，型號不一致。

41.en: The speakers do not describe any test or power-on failure.
41.zh: 對話沒有討論產品功能故障。

41.en: The discussion is about outbound labeling, not the carrier’s address.
41.zh: 沒有提到承運商地址問題。

42.en: The man expressly says he has already stopped the shipment.
42.zh: 他在開頭明說已停止出貨。

42.en: Reprinting every label is not reported as completed; the speakers are investigating the print history and have not authorized relabeling.
42.zh: 對話只說要查列印紀錄，且核准前不得重貼，沒有說已重印全部標籤。

42.en: An outdated template is suspected; the printer was not discarded.
42.zh: 印表機僅被懷疑用了舊模板，沒有被丟棄。

42.en: The speakers neither discuss nor report changing the customer order.

43.en: Approval from the quality team is required, not a new order.
43.zh: 本題所需的是品質部門核准，不是新採購單。

43.en: The boxes already have a marked holding area; enlarging it is not a condition.
43.zh: 已指定現有暫存區，沒有擴大區域要求。

43.en: Correcting a label does not require substituting another product model.
43.zh: 處理的是標籤更正，未要求更換產品。

43.en: The woman explicitly prohibits relabeling until the quality team approves the correction.
43.zh: 女方要求品質部門核准更正後才能重貼。
